clues.text: This city sits where two rivers join, near the middle of its state. It grew where the two streams meet and flow on as one.
clues.narrowing: Rules out coasts and border towns; puts the player where two rivers join, near the state's centre.

source.quote: Columbus was founded in 1812 at the confluence of the Scioto and Olentangy rivers.

clues.text: Snow stays light here, since this city sits too far from the great lakes for their big lake snows. Yet those lakes still send long grey cloudy spells in winter.
clues.narrowing: Rules out deep snow lake towns; snow is light here, but grey cloudy spells drag on in winter.

source.quote: It is also too far south and west for lake-effect snow from Lake Erie to have much effect, although the lakes to the north contribute to long stretches of cloudy spells in winter.

clues.text: The state's chiefs kept moving the capital from town to town. So in 1812 they built a new city in the centre and made it the capital in 1816.
clues.narrowing: Shrinks the list to a brand new city built in 1812 to end the moving of a state capital.

source.quote: It was planned as the state capital due to its central location and officially became the capital in 1816.

clues.text: Just north of town, a zoo on the river banks is famed round the world, thanks to its director Jack Hanna. A top guide once named it the best zoo in the land.
clues.narrowing: Nearly decisive: a world famed zoo by the river, led by Jack Hanna, marks this city.

source.quote: It has a worldwide reputation, largely attributable to the efforts and promotion of director emeritus Jack Hanna.

clues.text: The lawmakers of Ohio meet in this city, in the statehouse built on a square set aside for it. From here they run the whole state.
clues.narrowing: Confirms it: the state's lawmakers meet in the statehouse in this city.

source.quote: The two spaces were set to become Capitol Square , including for the Ohio Statehouse

reveal.blurb: Lawmakers founded a brand new city at the meeting of two rivers in 1812 and made it their capital in 1816. It grew into the state's largest city, with a zoo known round the world. Columbus is the capital of Ohio.
